description: Browse numbered headings with complete distinct eight-digit rate-line relationships and independent ten-digit statistical counts. A unique combined ten-digit source row can establish an absent eight-digit relationship. Published subchapter titles group following headings when present. Chapters 98 and 99 expose actual published entries without synthetic four-digit headings; grouping is unavailable without sourced markers. Reserved chapters can return a successful empty collection.

chapter.description: Chapter 01–99, accepting one or two digits.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same tool with identical arguments.

limit.description: Requested items as a positive safe integer; effectiveLimit discloses clamping to at most 100, and pages may be byte limited. Keep the same requested limit for continuation.

name: usitc_browse_chapter

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_code`: Chapter is outside 01–99 or has invalid syntax. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor tool or chapter arguments differ. `cursor_expired`: Original chapter snapshot or edition is unavailable. `release_changed`: Edition changed twice during source assembly. `invalid_hierarchy`: Complete source rows cannot establish safe ancestry. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: One numbered entry with complete descendant counts.

code.description: Published heading or special-chapter numbered entry.

rateLineCount.description: Distinct verified eight-digit relationships, including unique combined rows, in this published subtree.

statisticalLineCount.description: Distinct ten-digit rows in this published subtree.

subchapter.description: Published subchapter locator only when independently established.

notice.description: Actionable next call for this particular empty result.

budgetLimited.description: True when the complete reply byte budget reduced this page.

effectiveLimit.description: Applied item ceiling after clamping to 100.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for every remaining whole item.

checkedAt.description: UTC time of the edition check.

title: Browse published HTS chapter headings
